narrative:
## Handover Summary — Reconciliation & Matching

Auto-reconciliation is above 93% across all chains. The remaining breaks are assigned to named controllers, each with the agent's suggested resolution.

## Key Decisions
• Three-way PO / receipt / invoice match with 0.5% tolerance approved for supplier invoices
• EAN-to-article mapping loaded from the Data Lake product dimension
• Net-of-fee settlement rule for card and Vipps MobilePay takings

## Recommendation for Intercompany
Store-owner intercompany is now the largest open item. Agree goods-in-transit and marketing-fund timing with Intersport and Sport 1 store owners before posting eliminations.

signals.title: New POS roll-out — cut-over plan
signals.excerpt: POS replacement rolling out chain by chain alongside the Business Central implementation with Tietoevry. Item master moves to EAN; settlement files change format at cut-over.

signals.title: Hybrid ownership — store-owner settlement
signals.excerpt: Intersport and Sport 1 stores are partly owned by local store owners. Group invoices goods, marketing fund and services; balances must be agreed store by store before consolidation.
